description: Ansys provides Fluent for computational fluid dynamics and coupled heat-transfer analysis. Engineers build geometry and meshes, assign boundary conditions and solve physical flow problems through the commercial software environment. Coverage and time resolution depend on the configured case. It is applicable to building ventilation and thermal studies, but the product page does not validate a particular infrastructure model. Published by Ansys. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: Commercial Ansys licence. Software access is paid under the provider’s terms. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-openfoam. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
